requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

678-5332-5670--52.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
678-5332-5670--52.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
When the creature dies, Carmen and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

618-4247-4681.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide with haste.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2438-2738-4314-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Pawn of Ulamog, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

277-851-4094-6441-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
277-851-4094-6441-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

1799-2579-2701-4050-7487.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Zealous Lorecaster, adding one mana of any color.
When Zealous Lorecaster dies, The Cauldron of Eternity triggers, putting Zealous Lorecaster from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Zealous Lorecaster from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Grenzo's ability any number of times.

3197-7343-7363.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and a Mutagen token due to Donatello.
Activate the Mutagen by paying {0} due to Mutagen Man, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Repeat from step 2.

1824-2530-6709-7351.easyPrerequisites:
You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
1824-2530-6709-7351.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Prism Ring triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

1824-2530-4740-6709.easyPrerequisites:
You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
1824-2530-4740-6709.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7155.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Arcbound Fiend.
When Arcbound Fiend dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Fiend's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Fiend from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2034-2811-3490-4017.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2811-3490-4017.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

2981-4112-6767.description:
Cast Rescue Skiff by paying {5}{W}.
When Rescue Skiff enter the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sharuum.
Holding priority, activate Megatog by sacrificing Rescue Skiff.
Resolve the Rescue Skiff trigger, returning Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Rescue Skiff.
Holding priority, activate Megatog by sacrificing Sharuum.
Resolve the Sharuum trigger, returning Rescue Skiff from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

325-1742-2428-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-1742-2428-6282.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1018-3821-6485.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
1018-3821-6485.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Cast Rally the Galadhrim by paying {2}{G}{U} and tapping Skullwinder and Peregrine Drake, targeting Skullwinder
Rally the Galadhrim's conspire ability triggers, copying it, targeting Peregrine Drake.
Resolve the copy of Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the original Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Skullwinder.
When the Skullwinder token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rally the Galadhrim from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, tapping the Skullwinder and Peregrine Drake tokens when casting Rally the Galadhrim instead.

4499-4893-5418.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Exhibition Magician.
When Exhibition Magician enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

2018-2438-5263.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a flying counter on it.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities from steps 1 and 3, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

213-2232-3569.notablePrerequisites:
Myojin of Life's Web has at least two divinity counters on it.
You have at least one other nonartifact creature card in hand.
213-2232-3569.description:
Activate Myojin of Life's Web by removing a divinity counter from it, putting Pollenbright Druid and another nonartifact creature from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Pollenbright Druid and the additional creature enter the battlefield, Bloom Hulk triggers once and Cloudstone Curio triggers twice.
Resolve the Pollenbright Druid trigger, putting a divinity counter on Myojin of Life's Web.
Resolve both Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Pollenbright Druid and the additional creature to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

897-4050-4424.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Branchsnap Lorian, adding {G}.
When Branchsnap Lorian dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Branchsnap Lorian from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

539-3467-4290.notablePrerequisites:
Sculptor of Winter does not have summoning sickness.
Darksteel Garrison attached to Sculptor of Winter.
539-3467-4290.description:
Activate Sculptor of Winter by tapping it, targeting itself.
Darksteel Garrison triggers, giving target creature +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Sculptor of Winter ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

527-2816.notablePrerequisites: Selvala does not have summoning sickness.
527-2816.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to the greatest power among creatures you control.
Activate Selvala by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

47-2232-2858-3273.description:
Pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice putting Chandra Nalaar onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, Torch of Defiance to your hand.
+1 Chandra Nalaar targeting an opponent.
Then pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice once again, putting Chandra, Torch of Defiance onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra Nalaar to your hand.
+1 Chandra adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

1661-3581-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat

772-2034-3175.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Repeat.

985-4985-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat
